svg.title: Blue Green Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; interpretive screen colours. Observed triangular outer canvas points left. Green lower field has an upward-curving top boundary; wall and cast shadow remain absent. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of green, blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.moca.org/artworks/blue-green-curve; object 85.57; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
